entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-08
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Failure to select an element using XAML Live Preview #31928
  • [NET10.0] Change all defaults of SafeAreaEdges so that they will return "None" as the default if the user hasn't set the value #31925
    .NET 10.0 GA
  • MAUI Blazor Hybrid + Web template can't load blazor.web.js #31923
  • SwipeItemView and SwipeItem background doesn’t update on AppTheme change (Light/Dark) #31917
  • [Windows/Android] Header/Footer re-add and removal issues in CollectionView #31911

Closed

  • Enable MAUI SDK diagnostics by default for Aspire #31846
    .NET 10.0 GA
